aspects.name: Auth & Security Patterns
aspects.summary: Authentication and authorization are exceptionally well-implemented. RLS policies comprehensively isolate private and household data, SECURITY DEFINER functions correctly scope search paths, and tokens are securely stored using Expo SecureStore rather than AsyncStorage.

aspects.name: Naming Conventions
aspects.summary: Boolean and variable namings are consistent, but the codebase has notable violations of its own documented directory and folder layout rules.

aspects.name: Code Reuse & Duplication
aspects.summary: The codebase has very good separation of concerns and extracts complex logic properly (like `normalizeUnit`), but there is some duplicated boilerplate logic in UI form components.

aspects.name: General Best Practices
aspects.summary: The codebase adheres well to general best practices and project conventions, with a few isolated type escape hatches in sync logic and a forbidden command mention in seed scripts.

findings.title: Flat folder structure in large features violates AGENTS.md conventions
findings.description: The `inventory` and `calorie-tracking` features contain nearly 30 files each in their root directories, mixing screens, APIs, hooks, and tests. This violates the project's own explicit rule in `AGENTS.md`: "sobald ein Feature spürbar wächst, wird nach Verantwortungsschicht getrennt (screens/, sheets/, forms/, components/, hooks/, domain/)".
findings.recommendation: Refactor these overgrown flat directories to follow the layered folder structure defined in `AGENTS.md` (as successfully demonstrated by `src/features/shopping-list/`).

findings.title: Denglish folder name 'domain-logik' diverges from stated convention
findings.description: The folder `domain-logik` mixes English and German and contradicts the explicitly documented layout rule in `AGENTS.md` which dictates `domain/` for domain logic.
findings.recommendation: Rename `src/features/shopping-list/domain-logik` to `src/features/shopping-list/domain` to match the documented architecture guidelines and maintain English naming consistency.

findings.title: Duplicated date formatting helpers
findings.description: The `toIsoDate` and `formatIsoDate` helper functions are duplicated exactly in both `date-wheel-field.tsx` and `date-wheel-field.android.tsx`. Furthermore, `date-picker.tsx` implements nearly identical date string construction inline.
findings.recommendation: Extract `toIsoDate` and `formatIsoDate` (or equivalent date formatting logic) into a shared utility file (e.g. `src/lib/date-utils.ts`) and import it in all date picker components.

findings.title: Banned 'bun test' command referenced
findings.description: The script instructs users/agents to run 'bun test' as a success criteria (lines 133 and 444). This violates the explicit AGENTS.md rule 'Niemals bun test ausführen', as it uses Bun's native runner which ignores the jest.config.js configuration and will fail.
findings.recommendation: Change the mentions of `bun test` to `bun run test` in scripts/seed-issues.sh.

findings.title: Type-safety escape hatch for Supabase client
findings.description: Uses `supabase.from(meta.table) as any` to bypass TypeScript's strict type checking for the table name string literal. This pattern is repeated multiple times in pull.ts and push.ts. While it circumvents a TypeScript limitation with dynamic table names, it drops type safety for the query builder entirely.
findings.recommendation: Define a union type of all valid table names (e.g. `keyof Database['public']['Tables']`) and cast the dynamic variable to it, or create a type-safe generic wrapper to avoid casting the entire query builder to `any`.
